# Pillar FAC01: Value loading (common factor set)
Definition: HML beta from a 60-month Newey-West regression of the reference index's USD excess return on one common factor set: Ken French Developed Mkt-RF, SMB, HML, RMW, CMA_perp and Developed WML. This set is used for every equity sleeve (S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, EXUS, EIMI) and for VWRA. EIMI's regression on Developed factors is a disclosed approximation, with a REC04 sensitivity run on the Emerging set. Estimated monthly using only data released by then (1-month lag; Ken French files are revised vintages, disclosed), shrunk by min(1, |t| / 2) and scored as the loading minus VWRA's loading on the same set. Weight 0.12 of FAC (4.8% of X), inside the value-cluster cap.
Source: Ken French Developed 5 factors and Developed momentum files (verified, 1990-07 to 2026-09); yfinance monthly returns and ELG07 splices (verified). Better when: higher. Informs: portfolio_mix.
Week 2026-W46.
